description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three multimodal large language models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across three reasoning benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 35 to 80 in increments of 5, while the horizontal axis lists the benchmarks. For MathVista, SRPO-7B achieves the highest score of 75.8 (dark blue), followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3 (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2 (light blue). In MathVerse, SRPO-7B again leads with 55.8, GRPO-7B scores 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 46.3. On the Physics benchmark, SRPO-7B scores 60.6, GRPO-7B scores 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 45.4. Across all benchmarks, SRPO-7B consistently outperforms the other two models, with the performance gap most pronounced in Physics. The bars are grouped by benchmark, with each model’s performance represented by a distinct shade of blue, and numerical scores are labeled atop each bar for clarity. The chart visually supports the paper’s claim that SRPO enhances multimodal reasoning through reflection-aware reinforcement learning.
